en: Dependent on an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by vision, there arises a non-unwholesome state that is not to be abandoned by vision, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for the root condition, three for the predominance condition … pe … three for the non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is to be abandoned by cultivation, there arises a non-unwholesome state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for the root condition, three for the predominance condition … pe … three for the non-disappearance condition.

Conditioned by an indeterminate state that is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, there arises an indeterminate state that is to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
